outside_telegram.title: Open from Telegram
outside_telegram.body: This app only works inside Telegram. Open it from the FLIRT bot chat.

expired.title: Session expired
expired.body: Your Telegram sign-in data has expired. Close the app and reopen it from the chat.

invalid.title: Invalid sign-in data
invalid.body: Telegram could not confirm your identity. Reopen the app from the official bot chat.

network.title: No connection
network.body: We can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

server.title: Server not responding
server.body: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment.

feed.sendFailed: We couldn't send that. Try again.
feed.undoFailed: We couldn't undo that. Try again.
feed.hint: Drag the card: left = no, right = like, up = super like, down = back.
feed.emptyBody: This isn't an error: there really is nobody left to show right now. Come back later or widen your filters in Settings.

welcome.title: Welcome to FLIRT
welcome.body: Your account already exists — you signed in with Telegram. All that's left is your profile, so others have something to see.
welcome.note: No password, no SMS code. We start from your Telegram name and photo — you can change both.

onboarding.title: Your profile
onboarding.subtitle: Fields marked with * are required. It takes a minute.

hints.adultsOnly: FLIRT is 18+. You must be at least {{min}}.
hints.interestedIn: Optional. Pick nothing and we'll show you everyone.

errors.birthDateInvalid: That date of birth isn't valid.
errors.birthDateFuture: Your date of birth can't be in the future.
errors.tooYoung: FLIRT is adults only: you must be at least {{min}}.
errors.heightRange: Height must be between {{min}} and {{max}} cm.
errors.referenceFailed: We couldn't load the options. Check your connection and try again.
errors.saveFailed: We couldn't save your profile. Try again.
errors.network: We can't reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.uploadFailed: We couldn't upload the photo. Try again.
errors.deleteFailed: We couldn't delete the photo. Try again.
errors.photoType: That file isn't an image. Pick a photo.
errors.photoDecode: We couldn't open that photo. Some formats (HEIC, the iPhone default) can't be read here — pick another photo or save it as JPEG.
errors.photoTooLarge: The photo is over the {{limit}} limit.
errors.photoStillTooLarge: The photo is still too large ({{size}}) even after shrinking, and the limit is {{limit}}. Pick another one.
errors.notCompleteYet: The server says your profile still isn't complete. You need at least {{min}} photos.

photos.title: Your photos
photos.needMore: Add {{n}} more photos to get started (minimum {{min}}).
photos.enough: You have enough photos. Add more if you like.
photos.limits: Up to {{max}} photos. We shrink them under {{size}} before sending.
